title: Maintenance of information by consumer mediation cell
description: Maintenance of information by the consumer mediation cell

steps.step: Consumer mediation cell maintains information under sub-section (4) of section 74

documents: maintenance of any other information by the consumer mediation cell under sub-section (4) of section 74
quarterly report by consumer mediation cell to the District Commission, the State Commission or the National Commission under sub-section (5) of section 74
the qualifications and experience required for empanelment as mediator
the manner of training empanelled mediators
the fee payable to empanelled mediator
the code of conduct for empanelled mediators
the grounds on which, and the manner in which, empanelled mediators shall be removed or empanelment shall be cancelled
the other matters relating thereto under sub-section (2) of section 75
the conditions for re-empanelment of mediators for another term under sub-section (3) of section 75
the other facts to be disclosed by mediators under clause (c) of section 77
the time within which, and the manner in which, mediation may be conducted under sub-section (3) of section 79
such other matter for which provision is to be, or may be, made by regulation
